# Nehemiah Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 472r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_008_page_001.jpg

---

**8:1** And-all the-people gathered [va-ye'asfu] as-one man [ke-ish echad] to the-square [ha-rechov] that [was] before the-Water Gate [Sha'ar ha-Mayim], and-they-said to-Ezra the-scribe [ha-sofer] to-bring [le-havi] the-book [sefer] of-the-Torah of-Mosheh which YHWH had-commanded [tsivvah] Yisra'el.

**8:2** And-Ezra the-priest [ha-kohen] brought the-Torah before the-assembly [ha-qahal], from-man [me-ish] and-unto woman [ve-ad ishah] and-all who-could-understand [mevin] in-hearing [lishmo'a], on-the-first day [be-yom echad] of-the-seventh month [la-chodesh ha-shevi'i].

**8:3** And-he-read [va-yiqra] in-it before the-square that [was] before the-Water Gate from-the-light [min ha-or] until midday [machatsit ha-yom], before the-men and-the-women and-those-who-understood [ha-mevinim]; and-the-ears [oznei] of-all the-people [were toward] the-book of-the-Torah.

**8:4** And-Ezra the-scribe stood upon a-tower [migdal] of-wood [ets] which they-had-made for-the-purpose [la-davar], and-beside-him stood Mattityah and-Shema and-Anayah and-Uriyyah and-Chilqiyyah and-Ma'aseyah on-his-right-hand [al yemino], and-on-his-left [u-mi-smolo] Pedayah and-Misha'el and-Malkiyyah and-Chashum and-Chashbaddanah, Zekharyah, Meshullam.

**8:5** And-Ezra opened [va-yiftach] the-book [ha-sefer] before-the-eyes [le-eyney] of-all the-people, for he-was above all the-people, and-when-he-opened-it [u-khe-fitcho] all the-people stood-up [amdu].

**8:6** And-Ezra blessed [va-yevareikh] YHWH the-God the-great [ha-gadol], and-all the-people answered [va-ya'anu], "Amen, Amen [amen amen]!" lifting-up [be-mo'al] their-hands [yedeyhem]. And-they-bowed [va-yiqdu] and-prostrated [va-yishtachavu] to-YHWH, faces [appayim] to-the-ground [artsah].

**8:7** And-Yeshua and-Bani and-Sherevyah, Yamin, Aqqub, Shabbetay, Hodiyyah, Ma'aseyah, Qelita, Azaryah, Yozavad, Chanan, Pelayah, and-the-Levi'im, were-causing-the-people-to-understand [mevinim et ha-am] the-Torah, and-the-people [were standing] in-their-place [al omdam].

**8:8** And-they-read [va-yiqre'u] in-the-book, in-the-Torah of-God, distinctly [meforash], and-giving [ve-som] understanding [sekhel], and-they-understood [va-yavinu] the-reading [ba-miqra].

**8:9** And-Nechemyah — he [is] the-Tirshata — and-Ezra the-priest the-scribe, and-the-Levi'im who-were-causing-the-people-to-understand, said to-all the-people, "This-day [ha-yom ha-zeh] is-holy [qadosh] to-YHWH your-God. Do-not mourn [al tit'abbelu] and-do-not weep [ve-al tivku]." For all the-people were-weeping [bokhim] when-they-heard [ke-shom'am] the-words of-the-Torah.

**8:10** And-he-said to-them, "Go [lekhu], eat [ikhlu] rich-foods [mashmannim] and-drink [u-shetu] sweet-drinks [mamtaqqim], and-send portions [manot] to-him-for-whom nothing [eyn] is-prepared [nakhon], for this-day is-holy to-our-Lord. And-do-not grieve [al te'atsevu], for the-joy of-YHWH [chedvat YHWH] is your-strength [ma'uzzekhem]."

**8:11** And-the-Levi'im were-quieting [machasim] all the-people, saying, "Be-still [hassu], for the-day is-holy; and-do-not grieve."

**8:12** And-all the-people went to-eat and-to-drink and-to-send portions and-to-make great joy [simchah gedolah], for they-understood [hevinu] the-words which were-made-known [hodia'u] to-them.

**8:13** And-on-the-second day [u-va-yom ha-sheni] were-gathered the-heads of-the-fathers [rashey ha-avot] of-all the-people, the-priests, and-the-Levi'im, to Ezra the-scribe, to-give-attention [le-haskil] to the-words of-the-Torah.

**8:14** And-they-found written [katuv] in-the-Torah which YHWH had-commanded by-the-hand of-Mosheh, that the-sons of-Yisra'el should-dwell [yeshvu] in-booths [ba-sukkot] in-the-feast [be-chag] of-the-seventh month,

**8:15** and-that they-should-proclaim [yashmi'u] and-cause-to-pass [ve-ya'aviru] a-voice [qol] in-all their-cities and-in-Yerushalayim, saying, "Go-out [tse'u] to-the-mountain [ha-har] and-bring [ve-havi'u] olive [zayit] branches [aley] and-wild-olive [ets shemen] branches and-myrtle [hadas] branches and-palm [temarim] branches and-branches of-thick-trees [ets avot], to-make booths [sukkot], as-it-is-written [ka-katuv]."

**8:16** And-the-people went-out and-brought [them] and-made for-themselves booths, each on-his-roof [al gago] and-in-their-courtyards [be-chatseroteyhem] and-in-the-courtyards of-the-house of-God [beyt ha-Elohim] and-in-the-square of-the-Water Gate and-in-the-square of-the-Gate of-Efrayim [Sha'ar Efrayim].

**8:17** And-all the-assembly [ha-qahal] of-those-who-returned from-the-captivity [ha-sheviyyah] made booths and-dwelt in-the-booths, for the-sons of-Yisra'el had-not done so [lo asu khen] from-the-days of-Yeshua [Yehoshua] son of-Nun until that-day [ad ha-yom ha-hu]. And-there-was very great joy [simchah gedolah me'od].

**8:18** And-he-read [va-yiqra] in-the-book of-the-Torah of-God day by-day [yom be-yom], from the-first day until the-last day [ha-yom ha-acharon]. And-they-kept the-feast [va-ya'asu chag] seven days [shiv'at yamim], and-on-the-eighth day [u-va-yom ha-shemini] a-solemn-assembly [atseret], according-to-the-ordinance [ka-mishpat].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **8:1 "as one man"** — The phrase *ke-ish echad* emphasizes the unity of the assembly; the entire community gathered with singular purpose.
2. **8:8 "distinctly"** — Hebrew *meforash* may mean "with translation/interpretation" (possibly into Aramaic for those who no longer understood Hebrew) or "clearly/distinctly." The Talmud (Nedarim 37b) understands this as Targum.
3. **8:10 "the joy of YHWH is your strength"** — One of the most quoted phrases in the Hebrew Bible; *chedvat YHWH* uses an Aramaic-influenced word for joy, suggesting post-exilic linguistic development.
4. **8:17 "since the days of Joshua son of Nun"** — This does not mean Sukkot was never observed, but that it had not been celebrated with this level of communal participation and joy since the conquest era.

*— EMET*
